_note: Edit(allow)→allowWrite, Edit(deny)→denyWrite, Read(deny)→denyRead, WebFetch(domain:...)→network.allowedDomains. NOTE: there is NO Read(allow)→allowRead branch in claude-code (sandbox-adapter.ts:309-326 walks permissions.allow for Edit only, and permissions.deny for Edit+Read); allowRead is sourced EXCLUSIVELY from sandbox.filesystem.allowRead (sandbox-adapter.ts:343-347). So a Read(allow) rule contributes nothing → allowRead stays []. allowWrite is seeded with '.' (cwd is always writable, sandbox-adapter.ts:225) BEFORE rule-derived paths; with a Default SandboxConvertContext (no claudeTempDir/seed paths) the only seed is '.'. Bash(...) intentionally ignored — its decision lives in should_use_sandbox. claude-code's path-resolver treats `/path` as relative to the settings directory and `//path` as an absolute escape hatch — see resolve_path_pattern_for_sandbox in path_pattern.rs.
